traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description:
You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a legacy from the Fiendish Legacies table. You gain the level 1 benefit of the chosen legacy. | Legacy | Level 1 | Level 3 | Level 5 | | -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | | • Abyssal | Resistance to Poison.
Learns _Poison Spray_ cantrip. | _Ray of Sickness_ | _Hold Person_| | • Chthonic | Resistance to Necrotic.
Learns _Chill Touch_ cantrip. | _False Life_ | _Ray of Enfeeblement_ | | • Infernal | Resistance to Fire.
Learns _Fire Bolt_ cantrip. | _Hellish Rebuke_ | _Darkness_ |

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.
